name: Inositol phosphate and pyrophosphate metabolism with inositol transport
rationale: Members cover synthesis and turnover of inositol phosphates, diphosphoinositol and diadenosine polyphosphates; inositol transport and ER-lumen IP synthesis set it apart from PIP/PTEN and nucleotide interconversion neighbours.

name: Prostate gland and male genitalia development
rationale: All members concern prostate bud, branching, acinus and glandular epithelium or male genitalia morphogenesis, distinguishing it from salivary, mammary, gonadal and female tract neighbours.

core: Lipid mediator G protein-coupled receptor signalling
name: Lipid mediator GPCR signalling through G beta-gamma effectors
rationale: Members are leukotriene, prostanoid and sphingosine-1-phosphate GPCR signalling plus G beta-gamma signalling via PLC beta and PI3K gamma, which the leukotriene-synthesis, histamine and calcium neighbours lack.

core: RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and ribosome biogenesis
name: MYC-target ribosome biogenesis and RNA polymerase I transcription
rationale: Members regulate Pol I rRNA transcription, nucleolar chromatin and ribosome biogenesis; the MYC target sets distinguish it from Pol I/II/III initiation and rRNA processing neighbours.

qualifier: nuclear exosome RNA decay and surveillance
name: Spliceosomal splicing and nuclear exosome RNA decay and surveillance
rationale: Members cover spliceosome assembly and splicing together with exosome-mediated 3'-5' decay and surveillance of mRNA, rRNA, snRNA and tRNA, which the snRNP assembly, 3'-end processing and export neighbours lack.

qualifier: chambers, septa and endocardial cushion valves
name: Heart chamber, septum and endocardial cushion valve development
rationale: Members span myocardial chamber, septum and valve development via endocardial cushion EMT, whereas neighbours focus on conduction system, coronary vasculature or outflow tract.

qualifier: ephrin, netrin, Slit-Robo, semaphorin cues and sprouting
name: Axon guidance and sprouting via ephrin, netrin, Slit-Robo, semaphorin
rationale: Members are axon guidance, fasciculation, collateral sprouting and regeneration driven by ephrin, netrin, Slit-Robo, semaphorin and L1/DSCAM cues, broader in receptor families than each neighbour.

core: Regulation of synapse organization and transmission
name: Regulation of synapse organization, transmission and neuron maturation
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle clustering, transmitter release and uptake, postsynaptic membrane organization, LTP, and neuron maturation, unlike the vesicle-recycling and clathrin endocytosis neighbours.

name: Activin and FSH signalling in testis Sertoli cell development
rationale: Members combine FSH/gonadotropin and activin/AMH signalling with Sertoli cell proliferation and seminiferous tubule development, whereas neighbours concern LH, GnRH and ovarian follicle biology.

name: Regulation of neutrophil chemotaxis and extravasation
rationale: All members regulate neutrophil or granulocyte chemotaxis, migration and diapedesis, distinguishing it from formyl peptide receptor, neutrophil activation and integrin/T cell neighbours.

name: miRNA turnover and miRNA-directed mRNA deadenylation decay
rationale: Members cover miRNA degradation and processing control plus miRNA-driven mRNA deadenylation, poly(A) shortening and P-body assembly, unlike neighbours on miRNA biogenesis, RISC and translational repression.

name: Pancreatic progenitor, ductal and endocrine cell lineage development
rationale: Members trace pancreatic progenitor, ductal and endocrine lineages with neuroendocrine and adrenal differentiation and HNF factors, distinct from endoderm, intestinal, beta cell function and gonadal neighbours.

qualifier: retinoid visual cycle and its disorders
name: Visual phototransduction and retinoid cycle with vitamin A metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin A/retinoic acid metabolism, the rod and cone retinoid cycles, opsin phototransduction and their genetic defects, unlike retinal development and vitamin D/K neighbours.

name: APC/C regulation and Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switch at mitotic exit
rationale: Members concern APC/C phosphorylation, inhibition and Cdc20-mediated degradation of cyclin B and securin, with the Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switch distinguishing it from neighbours.

core: Telomere maintenance and DNA repair regulation
qualifier: telomere end protection and DNA topology remodeling
name: Telomere end protection and DNA structural remodeling in repair
rationale: Members cover telomere capping, recombination and replication with DNA topological change, fork reversal, R-loop processing and NHEJ restraint, unlike C-strand synthesis and replication stress neighbours.

name: T cell integrin adhesion and immunological synapse formation
rationale: Members cover integrin activation and leukocyte adhesion with T cell polarity, membrane rafts and immunological synapse formation, unlike extravasation and CD28-Vav1 neighbours.

qualifier: store-operated entry and ER-mitochondria calcium transfer
name: Store-operated calcium entry and ER-mitochondria calcium transfer
rationale: Members cover calcium sensing, store-operated entry, ER calcium depletion and mitochondrial calcium uptake via ER-mitochondria tethering, unlike ryanodine release and voltage-gated channel neighbours.

name: Naive and memory B cell surface signatures
rationale: Members are B cell, naive and memory B cell expression signatures and immune memory, distinguished from germinal centre, plasma cell and B cell activation neighbours.

name: Golgi nucleotide sugar transport and transporter-defect glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members concern nucleotide sugar supply and SLC35/SLC33A1 transport into the Golgi and the disorders their defects cause, unlike glycosphingolipid, N-glycan, GPI and sialic acid metabolism neighbours.

name: Cardiomyocyte ion homeostasis, membrane potential and calcium release
rationale: Members concern ion homeostasis, cardiac muscle membrane potential and sarcoplasmic calcium release in contraction, distinct from contractile force, conduction and SA node neighbours.

qualifier: secondary heart field and cardiac mesoderm specification
name: Secondary heart field and cardiac mesoderm specification
rationale: Members cover cardiac mesoderm fate, secondary heart field specification and proliferation, early heart tube, pericardium and coronary vasculogenesis, unlike septum, conduction and outflow tract neighbours.

name: Myoblast proliferation, migration and fusion
rationale: All three members concern myoblast proliferation, migration and fusion in regeneration, distinct from neighbours on myoblast differentiation and satellite cell control.

qualifier: glycosylase BER, alkylation reversal and active demethylation
name: Glycosylase base excision repair, alkylation reversal and DNA demethylation
rationale: Members cover DNA glycosylase-initiated base excision repair and its defects, direct alkylation reversal, TET-TDG demethylation and crosslink repair, unlike editing, translesion and mismatch repair neighbours.

name: Regulation of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization in apoptosis
rationale: All members positively or negatively regulate apoptotic MOMP and cytochrome c release, whereas neighbours describe specific BCL-2 family, apoptosome or oxidative stress events.

qualifier: amino acids, peptides, polyamines and urate
name: Amino acid, peptide, polyamine and urate solute carrier transport
rationale: Members cover SLC-mediated plasma membrane transport of amino acids, oligopeptides, polyamines, urate and organic ions and renal transporter disorders, unlike monocarboxylate/organic acid and hexose transport neighbours.
